title: neogaerrhinum kelloggii
intro: Neogaerrhinum kelloggii, commonly known as Kellogg's gerrhinum, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Neogaerrhinum kelloggii include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity.
